title: A literal URL at `Core\Http\Client::stream`, `Core\Http\Client::openSocket` and `Core\Http::allowUrl` is not read while checking.
text: `rule:security/outbound-url-is-a-sink` says a literal at an outbound URL parameter is validated while checking (`rule:expressions/intrinsic-literals`). The roster has a `Grammar::Uri` row for `Core\Uri::parse` and for the seven request members `get` to `head` and `request` (`tests/conformance/reject/a-malformed-literal-url-at-the-http-client-is-a-compile-error.nvst`), and none for these three. `Grammar::Uri` also refuses a port past `65535`, which `Core\Http::allowUrl`'s `judged_host` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http.rs` never reads. So a row there would refuse what the runtime accepts, and `rule:expressions/preparation-preserves-behaviour` forbids that. Closing it is confirming each member's runtime refuses both halves of `nvs_stdlib::uri::validate` (or making it refuse them), then a row per member and a line each in that case.
